report:
RESULTS.md written with all five configurations; run1 to run3 are measured, run4 and run5 are marked "not run" because they have no result files.
I did not fill in Dana's estimates from NOTES.md. They would show as measured numbers, and the measured runs contradict them: run3 shows 20 GPU layers cut speed by 68% (Dana: run4 only 10% below run2), and run2 shows a bigger quant is slower (Dana: f16 run5 faster than q4 run1).
Open: run4 and run5 must be run to fill the table with real numbers before the review. If Dana still wants estimates shown, they should be in a separate column labelled "estimate, not measured".
